title: Incremental Update Summarization: Adaptive Sentence Selection based on Prevalence and Novelty
abstract: Studies incremental summarization of evolving streams and adaptively selects updates using prevalence and novelty, explicitly addressing redundancy and information that becomes outdated as events develop.

title: TREC 2015 Temporal Summarization Track Overview
abstract: Describes evaluation of online temporal summarization for evolving events, including nugget-based comprehensiveness together with novelty, usefulness, and timeliness of successive updates.
